title: Engagement Manager
description:
This position is responsible for providing leadership, management and strategy for the sell with/go-to-market engagement and all joint activities with GCP. The Engagement Manager will be part of the team that coordinates Palo Alto Networks sales activities and will be a central conduit for engagement management between the Palo Alto Network’s sales organization and GCP. He will report to the director for Service Providers but will have several dotted line coordination requirements for consistent communication and engagement with Business Development, Marketing, Channels, Inside Sales and Product Marketing/Development. This position will be knowledge expert on all aspects of GCP and will be asked to present at QBRs, executive meetings, training and events.

The GCP Engagement Manager is regarded to be highly strategic to the company and the Public Cloud initiative in regards to strategy, influence and execution. The Engagement manager is required to contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Public Cloud strategy outside of their day-to-day activities and will be called upon for their subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities. It is expected that he chases consistent interaction and engagement with customers, strategic vendors, channel partners and other third parties in support of the “sell with” activities with GCP. The Engagement manager will demonstrate a deep understanding of GCP go-to-market strategies including but not limited to co-selling, strategic planning and goal setting, channel programs, marketing campaigns and programs, strategic events and funnel management.

o Manage joint sell with and go to market activities with GCP

o Track all opportunities, pipeline and bookings and provide forecasts and funnel management reports

o Facilitate co-selling opportunities, account mapping and other sales engagements between Palo Alto Network’s field sales and the GCP sales teams

o Support Palo Alto Network’s field sales organization on engagement management with GCP.

o Assist with providing content for Google Cloud training curriculum and sales enablement

o Coordinate activities and have involvement with the Public Cloud virtual team of Business Development, Marketing, Product Management, Channels and Sales as part of cloud strategy

o Develop annual strategic plan and performance goals for assigned GCPr

o Provide support and coordination for channel activity with assigned Cloud Provider

o Understand and articulate Google Cloud strategic initiatives and gain a deep understanding of the activities, roadmap and vision of the Cloud Provider

o Provide an escalation point for pre-sales and post sales issues for any activity with the GCP

o Build and maintain relationships with key personnel in GCP to solidify Palo Alto Network’s standing and awareness within the provider and to assist in the development of key relationships with the extended Palo Alto Network’s cloud team and executives

o Direct engagement and partner relationships are a critical part of this role

o Help provide insight in the support of Google Cloud events and attend/participate in the events

o Provide support in the form of expertise and training for Palo Alto Network’s field sales enablement

Skills:

• YOUR EXPERIENCE

o BA, BS (or equivalent work experience), MBA preferred

o 5+ Years’ experience in Sales – Account or Channel Management

o Public Cloud experience preferred

o Channel experience including selling with or managing channel partners is preferred

o Channel Program experience is a plus

o Demonstrated history of managing quota bearing sales or channel teams

o Industry knowledge of security product market trends and directional awareness of Palo Alto Network’s roadmap and technology development efforts.

o The role calls for knowledge of competitive security products.

o Knowledge of how to deliver comprehensive security solutions to PAN’s customer base and maintains a general understanding of competitive selling strategies.

o Demonstrated ability to work in a virtual and matrix environment

o 25% Travel with ability to travel internationally

o Strong communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills

o "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to do whatever necessary to assist in winning business

title: Sales Manager
description:
Brazil's automotive distribution related

Job Title: Sales Channel & Network Development Manager/Supervisor

Department: Sales Department

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Reports to: Sales Director / General Manager, Brazil

you will be responsible for planning, developing, and managing the sales and service network from scratch. Your work directly impacts how efficiently our products reach end customers and serves as the foundation for business success. We are looking for an expert with in-depth knowledge of Brazil's automotive distribution sector, strong business development capabilities, and negotiation skills.

Core Objectives

Within the set timeframe, successfully develop and sign qualified secondary dealer/showroom partners in key Brazilian regions (e.g., São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul) to establish a high-quality, sustainable sales network that meets new vehicle sales, after-sales service, and customer experience targets.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Network Development & Planning – Analyze market trends, customer preferences, and competitor networks; create a development plan aligned with brand positioning.
  2. Partner Identification & Screening – Proactively identify and evaluate potential dealer investors through multiple channels.
  3. Business Negotiation & Signing – Lead negotiations, present BAIC’s value proposition, and finalize dealer agreements.
  4. Dealership Setup & Launch Support – Guide new partners in store setup according to brand standards and support pre-opening preparations.
  5. Dealer Relationship & Performance Management – Serve as the main point of contact, monitor performance, and coordinate internal support to ensure dealer success.
  6. Market Insight & Compliance – Gather market and competitor intelligence; ensure all activities comply with local laws and regulations.

Qualifications

Must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Chinese is a strong plus).
  • At least 5 years in Brazil’s automotive industry , with 3+ years specifically in dealer network development, dealer management, or large B2B sales .
  • Established network of automotive dealer investors in Brazil .
  • Strong negotiation, financial analysis, and contract management skills.
  • Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to travel frequently within Brazil.

Preferred:

  • Experience launching a new automotive brand or expanding a network in Brazil.
  • Background in multinational automotive companies (European, American, Japanese, Korean, or Chinese).
  • Understanding of the Chinese automotive industry.

Personal Attributes:

  • Entrepreneurial spirit and self-motivated.
  • Resilient in the face of challenges.
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution ability.
  • High integrity and professionalism.

We Offer

  • Competitive salary (fixed + performance-based bonus tied to network targets).
  • Full statutory Brazilian benefits (13th salary, FGTS, vacation, VR/VA, etc.) + private health insurance.
  • Career growth linked to company and network performance.
  • Company car or transportation allowance.
